hero.label: Public university
hero.title: The Institution
hero.description: A public university committed to the sustainable development of northern Paraguay, with over a decade training excellent professionals.

about.label: Who we are
about.title: A university with its own identity
about.description: The Universidad Nacional de Concepción was created by Law No. 3,751/09 and is the only public university in northern Paraguay. Its mission is to train professionals with ethical values, critical thinking and social impact.

historia.label: Journey
historia.title: History
historia.description: Since its founding in 2007, UNC has grown to become the benchmark for higher education in northern Paraguay.
